record.question: Structure of DNA of the cell was described by:
record.explanation: Answer A: Watson and Crick. Watson and Crick proposed the double-helical structure of DNA in 1953, drawing on crucial X-ray diffraction evidence from Rosalind Franklin and Maurice Wilkins. The printed answer is the conventional attribution but incomplete as a historical account. Reference: https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/medicine/1962/summary/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
